note: Not yet implemented in either Fe or kg's prelude; (defcustom ...) is void-function in kg today. Emacs' defcustom defines and returns the symbol, evaluates the standard-value form when the variable is not already bound (leaving an already-bound variable alone, like defvar), stores the docstring, and records the presentation metadata (:type, :options, :group, :tag, :link, :version, :package-version) without engaging Custom's UI or any dynamic-binding machinery kg does not have.
